_tieu_de: Do markup THAT cua menu Edit/Delete (nut 3 cham) LUC DANG MO tren ban dien thoai -- gap ghi trong ISSUES.md 'Menu Edit/Delete cua nut 3 cham chua co anh chup luc MO, tam dung __moMenuChon dung chung cua Select'.
_cach_do: Vao Advanced > LAN. Chen iframe cung-origin rong 420px vao trang chinh (ky thuat da dung nhieu lan truoc: SPA tu doc innerWidth cua iframe de ve dung layout dien thoai).
Doc contentDocument, tim cac <button> chua svg data-testid MoreVertRoundedIcon (3 nut, ung voi 3 dong: '0 selected', dong MAC d8:43:ae:2e:65:45 (Admin-PC, id cfg08fe63), dong MAC 22:ca:16:9a:7a:d5).
Bam nut 3 cham cua dong Admin-PC (scrollIntoView roi .click()).
Doc DOM cua menu vua mo qua contentDocument (walk thu cong tung thuoc tinh vi outerHTML bi cong cu chan do trung mau 'query string').
Doc CSSOM (document.styleSheets) cho tung class Emotion lien quan.
KHONG bam Edit/Delete -- chi doc DOM/CSS luc mo, khong tao thay doi nao tren thiet bi.

ket_luan: Cau truc THAT khac han markup Select-popup dang tam dung: co icon (EditOutlinedIcon/DeleteOutlineRoundedIcon), co Divider giua Edit/Delete, role='menuitem' (khong phai 'option'), khong co data-value/aria-selected kieu Select.

Da them window.__moMenuBaCham(oNeo, dsTuyChon, khiChon) rieng trong dialog_data.js, dung dung markup nay. bang_binding.js's moMenuBaCham() doi tu goi __moMenuChon() sang __moMenuChon Chon Ba Cham moi, tai su dung D_EDIT/D_DEL da co san.

Them 4 luat CSS moi vao emotion.css: .css-cn14vc (paper, full-width dien thoai), .css-e68ia9 (menu item), .css-9y6cpa (divider), .css-8hzn2u (label). Cac lop .css-r8u8y9/.css-1f8bwsm/.css-1tsvksn/.css-vubbuv DA CO SAN tu lan do truoc, khong doi.

Dong gap trong ISSUES.md: menu 3 cham nay tu 'muc 2 (dung markup gia tam)' len 'muc 2 dung markup THAT + muc 1 dung hinh anh THAT' -- van la muc 2 vi day la giao dien tinh, chua co API rieng (Edit/Delete goi qua PATCH/DELETE cua bang da co san).
